title: 6 Day Uganda Honeymoon Safari: Lake Mburo, Lake Bunyonyi and Bwindi Gorillas
rank_math_title: Uganda Honeymoon Safari: 6 Days, Lakes and Gorillas
rank_math_desc: Uganda honeymoon safari for 6 days: zebras at Lake Mburo, two quiet nights on Lake Bunyonyi and a gorilla trek in Bwindi, with a flight back to Entebbe.
post_content: This Uganda honeymoon safari mixes gentle game viewing, island-dotted lake scenery and the thrill of meeting mountain gorillas together.
overview:
This Uganda honeymoon safari mixes gentle game viewing, island-dotted lake scenery and the thrill of meeting mountain gorillas together. Start at Mihingo Lodge in Lake Mburo National Park, spend two unhurried nights at Birdnest at Bunyonyi Resort on Lake Bunyonyi, then trek for gorillas from Buhoma Lodge in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest. A flight from Kihihi takes you back to Entebbe. It suits couples who want a romantic, less-travelled honeymoon with a real adventure at its heart.

Price: from USD 3,630 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Gorilla trekking permit in Bwindi included
Two relaxed nights on Lake Bunyonyi
Zebras and impalas in Lake Mburo National Park
Flight from Kihihi back to Entebbe

faq.q: How much does this Uganda honeymoon safari cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 3,630 per adult sharing, including the gorilla permit, based on low-season rates. We confirm the price for your dates when you enquire.

faq.q: Is gorilla trekking safe for couples?
faq.a: Yes. Treks are led by armed Uganda Wildlife Authority rangers and trackers, and groups are limited to eight visitors per gorilla family.

faq.q: When is the best time to go?
faq.a: June to September and December to February are drier and easier for trekking.

featured_image.alt: Uganda family safari – a young mountain gorilla lying on its back in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Entebbe to Lake Mburo
itinerary.content: Pick-up in Entebbe and drive west, crossing the equator, to Lake Mburo National Park. Evening game drive. Dinner and overnight at Mihingo Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Lake Mburo to Lake Bunyonyi
itinerary.content: Morning boat trip or walk, then drive to the terraced hills of Kigezi and Lake Bunyonyi. Dinner and overnight at Birdnest at Bunyonyi Resort.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Lake Bunyonyi
itinerary.content: Free day for a canoe trip between the islands, swimming or simply relaxing. Dinner and overnight at Birdnest at Bunyonyi Resort.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Lake Bunyonyi to Bwindi
itinerary.content: Drive to the Buhoma sector of Bwindi Impenetrable Forest. Afternoon community walk. Dinner and overnight at Buhoma Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Gorilla trekking
itinerary.content: Trek with rangers to spend one hour with a habituated mountain gorilla family. Dinner and overnight at Buhoma Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Fly to Entebbe
itinerary.content: Transfer to Kihihi airstrip for the scheduled flight back to Entebbe.

includes: Private 4x4 vehicle with English-speaking driver guide
One gorilla trekking permit per person
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
